intents.name: Payment Issue
intents.description: Customer has trouble making a payment or payment failed
exemplars: My payment didn't go through and I don't know why
I keep getting an error when trying to pay my bill online
The payment was declined but my card works everywhere else
I was double charged on my last payment
My autopay didn't process this month and now I have a late fee

intents.name: Billing Inquiry
intents.description: Customer wants to understand charges or billing details
exemplars: Can you explain these charges on my bill?
Why is my bill higher than usual this month?
I don't recognize a $15 charge on my statement
When is my next payment due?
How do I read my billing statement?

intents.name: Refund Request
intents.description: Customer requests a refund for charges or services
exemplars: I want a refund for the service outage last week
I was overcharged and need my money back
I cancelled within the trial period and was still charged
I need a refund because the product didn't work as advertised
Can I get a credit for the days my service was down?
I want my money back for the 3 days everything was completely down
I deserve a refund since my internet was out for a whole week
Give me a credit for the time my service wasn't working

intents.name: Plan Change
intents.description: Customer wants to modify their billing plan
exemplars: I want to switch to a cheaper plan
Can I upgrade my plan without changing my billing date?
What happens to my current balance if I change plans?
I need to downgrade because I'm not using all my data
Can I change from monthly to annual billing?
